run_librispeech_prep: run the script to download LibriSpeech data and extract fbank features for all splits
run_process_function: run the process function to extract features, create ZIP archives, and generate TSV manifests
run_main_cli: run the CLI with --output-root and --vocab-type flags to prepare LibriSpeech data
review_process_function: review the process function that downloads LibriSpeech splits and generates vocab and config files
refactor_process_function: refactor the process function to support custom dataset splits or different feature extraction methods
